name: KEIM Soldalit®
use: exterior façade — works on mineral and organic substrates
positioning: KEIM's flagship multi-substrate mineral silicate paint. Highly vapour-permeable; chemically bonds to substrate. Used in restoration + new façade work.
source: industry knowledge — KEIM Soldalit published TDS

name: KEIM Granital®
positioning: KEIM's pure mineral silicate paint for masonry, render, concrete. The historic flagship — 140+ years of installed reference.

name: KEIM Innostar®
positioning: Interior mineral silicate paint. Non-allergenic, breathable, low-VOC, AgBB-certified.

name: KEIM Concretal®
use: decorative concrete-effect coating on render / drywall / concrete
positioning: Decorative concrete-look finish in mineral chemistry. Architectural applications, museum-grade durability.

name: KEIM Design-Lasur
positioning: Translucent decorative mineral glazes for designer wall finishes.

name: KEIM Restauro line
positioning: KEIM's heritage-restoration line. Used on listed buildings, museums, monuments where chemical-bonding mineral paint is required (rather than acrylic which traps moisture).
